budget_to_bind_before_actual_math_readba.on_overrun: Preserve partial audit/failure; do not call incomplete readback a pass or silently raise limits.

capacity_basis.estimated_identity_and_separation_work: Approximately linear in actual retained certificate size and recorded inequality count; at most 24 million recorded exclusions across single and full producer phases. No full failed-channel search replay.
capacity_basis.UV_coverage_algorithm: Independent exact U-stratum sweep: select patches covering each full U point/open interval, union their closed V intervals, then check every required V stratum outside open cores or on any closed core boundary. At most 43 U strata, 43 V strata and 1024 patches for a ten-hole face. This avoids importing either V5 geometric implementation.

source_and_execution_checks: Bind archive size/SHA, ZIP CRC/member identities and current exact head/run/job/artifact/attempt metadata.

Bind actual lock and every owned stage contract, worker source, entry/controller receipt and exact output directory. Read actual memory/RSS/disk/output observations without inventing missing subsecond live samples.
Distinguish original R4 anchor, preserved actual V3/V4 heads, newly published V5 head, and artifact retrieval identity.
Retain pipeline stop point and verify later contracts/controllers/outputs absent after any failed stage. Do not equate completed verifier with threshold pass.

Use separately verified lossless original source projection, fixed original bridge, original source proof only for actual certificate-bearing frames. No repeated 65MB inventory decode and no original R4 enclosure regeneration.
independent_conditional_boundary_readbac: Reconstruct original oriented endpoints and their actual-side corner assignment from frozen source records; recompute four-cycle, exact delta, signed offsets and nonempty inward core.
Preserve conditional corner-closure and inner-wire-as-hole premises; never reinterpret ULP gaps as exact native closure.
Recover stationary old boxes with fullD, independently reconstruct affine inverse and projected outer UV box, verify each declared hole and every complete closed core boundary.
Verify all 0D/1D/2D UV strata by exact interval-union sweep, mapping and strict-empty/zero-width distinction, then add complete original D to moving patches.
Verify exact oldpiece-to-replacements lineage, preserve every original edge/vertex and whole fallback face, derive complete new boundary hull independently.
independent_tree_readback: Exact selected case-001/frame-1/root202 only for the single phase; original16 and all1474 ordered roots for complete full phase.
Reconstruct all binary children from registered model-boundary endpoints; every allocated node visited exactly once, positive directed volume conserved, root/cut closed carriers retained.
Verify every excluded open leaf by every complete boundary piece and a channel reaching known exterior; retain every nonexcluded positive thin/pending leaf.
Compare exact sums, counters, original float64-derived1e-7 threshold, unchanged fullD, conditional upper and actual independent checker verdict.
Full conditional upper=min(retained,unchanged coarse upper); retain inherited min(volume)+TOL premise and old raw pass fields separately.

control_readback.synthetic_analytic_controls: Verify actual executed synthetic positive/negative records separately; never convert them to real geometry clearance.
control_readback.real_controls: Read exact actual phase/root/leaf/channel/split/trim-boundary mutations and their locators. Confirm N/A only when that actual object is absent.
control_readback.independent_copied_mutations: At most one finite set of the existing applicable control types using this reviewer's independent predicates; record local audit rejections separately from remote verifier controls.

fail_stop_prerequisites.single_pass: Owned producer and independent verifier both complete; exact selected input and original TOL conditional pass; positive actual removed volume; at least one admitted face and hole. An actual split is not required because a complete single box may already be excluded.
fail_stop_prerequisites.full_entry: Same exact single prerequisite plus actual16-frame capacity preflight and source/output/contract/controller bindings.
fail_stop_prerequisites.partial_or_failed_run: Preserve real executed subset, absence of later stages, actual process errors, mathematical unresolved bounds, and the separate source-model scope.
